findings.decision: ClaimAsync and PublishAsync now explicitly dispose transaction ownership using the documented nonblocking Dispose path. Query scopes declared later dispose first; existing session closure still runs in the outer finally.
MaintainAsync now disposes its transaction on success and exceptions before existing session cleanup; no durable retention or cursor progress semantics were edited.
CreateAsync retains existing protected-commit transfer. Every created transaction not transferred is disposed. A failed Begin produces no transaction to dispose.

Existing bounded protection reservation, asynchronous DisposeAsync join, rollback-only protection removal and shutdown join remain unchanged. BindAttachmentAsync continues to transfer transaction ownership to this mechanism.

The fix closes omitted application owner disposal rather than increasing native resource caps to mask it.
